artworks.title: Falling Leaves
artworks.medium: pastel and conté crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (William A. Clark Collection, 1926)
artworks.description: This drawing shows a pastoral scene. Closest to us is a hill with some small, bare trees on the right. Some leaves fall from the branches, drifting towards the ground. A person stands among these trees with their back to us, looking out at the valley in the distance below. On the right, sheep seem to graze along this hill. The wide valley stretches away towards the horizon in shades of green and tan, and the sky above is pale orange with some white and pale-blue clouds.

artworks.title: The Church of San Giorgio Maggiore
artworks.medium: pastel and conté crayon on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of James Parmelee, 1941)

artworks.title: Male Torso with Pole
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on grey laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a male figure. The person is facing slightly to the right with arms raised above the head, holding onto a long object. The facial features are detailed with strong cheekbones and a focused expression, while the hair is short. The figure is bare-chested, showing muscular definition, with no visible clothing or accessories. The drawing is on light-colored paper with a neutral background.

artworks.title: Campo dei Frari, Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Mabel Stevens Smithers, 1952)
artworks.description: This painting shows a sunlit plaza with low steps leading to water at the bottom of the scene. The horizon is marked by rooftops of buildings, including a large red church on the right with round windows and an arched entrance. A few people stand in front of the church in the distance, indicated with small strokes of paint. Two people are present in the center of the painting, at the top of the steps that lead to the water - one standing and another seated on the steps. We can't see their faces, but they appear to have pale skin and wear dresses with shawls in shades of red, blue, white, and tan. The buildings are mostly in shades of cream and tan, and the sky above is mostly white with some hints of pale blue. The water at the bottom is gray, with some parts reflecting the white and blue of the sky. The brushstrokes are soft and visible, giving the scene a hazy appearance.

artworks.title: The Letter
artworks.medium: color softground etching, drypoint and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Josephine Boardman Crane, 1956)
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting at a writing desk as she licks an envelope in this vertical, color print. A table folds down or extends from a tall secretary desk to our right. The blotter on the table and the woman’s long dress are both cobalt blue. The dress has a vaguely floral pattern in white, and the jacket is open to reveal a vertically pleated, beige-pink shirt beneath. The woman’s skin is faintly tinted peach. Her black hair is pulled back over dark brows and a delicate nose. She holds the open flap of the envelope to her mouth with both hands. A piece of white paper lies on the desktop in front of her. She sits in a brown chair, and the wallpaper of the room is patterned with green and muted pink flowers against a white background. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin, “Imprimée par l’artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt (25 épreuves)."

artworks.title: In Vaudeville, the Bicycle Rider
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Mr. and Mrs. Francis Biddle, 1957)

artworks.title: Rooftops and Trees
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of George Biddle, 1974)

artworks.title: Holy Family with Saint Elizabeth and the Young John the Baptist
artworks.artist: Orazio de Santis, after Pompeo Cesura
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 24.77 × 18.73 cm (9 3/4 × 7 3/8 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: The image shows three adult figures and one child. The central adult figure, shown from the waist up, is seated and holding a child in her arms. She is positioned slightly to the right and appears to be looking down at the child. Her facial features are soft, with a serene expression, and she has wavy hair partially covered by a cloth, with a halo above her head. She is draped in flowing garments. The child she holds is nude, with curly hair, and sits on her lap. To the lower left, a small winged cherub is shown standing, holding a slender object. To the right of the central figure, an older man with curly hair and a beard sits, shown from the waist up, with his head resting on his hand. Another figure is partially visible on the far left, shrouded in drapery. The background features a draped curtain creating an intimate setting, with a glimpse of architectural elements to the right.

artworks.title: Templum Iunoni, ac Iovi Pavellennio (The Temple of Juno and Jupiter)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ancient ruins viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is set high, with scattered remnants and arches outlined against the sky. The ruins feature worn columns and arches with intricate carvings. The artwork is a detailed line drawing, using fine lines and hatching techniques to create depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia and black. Figures in classical attire are present, offering scale and human connection. In the background, the ruins extend further, leading the eye to hills and softly rendered clouds in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape with Shepherdess and Herd at a Watering Hole
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene viewed from above eye level. In the distance, there is a line of trees creating a horizon, with swirling clouds and birds in the sky. Close by, there are hills, cows being led, and two figures sitting on a rocky outcrop. The artist uses detailed linework and cross-hatching for texture, particularly in foliage and rocks. The image is rendered in monochromatic tones, black and white.

artworks.title: Rustic Village along a River with Travelers
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic landscape from an elevated angle. The cluster of buildings is spread out in the middle, with faint outlines of additional structures on the horizon. The artwork features detailed linework typical of etching, with delicate cross-hatching and intricate detailing in foliage and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic, in black and white tones. A large tree with branches, two figures near a waterway, cows grazing, and wispy clouds in the sky complete the scene.

artworks.title: The Coast of Elba
artworks.medium: etching [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a pebbled beach on the right meeting a grassy hill. The horizon is above the midline, the sea meets the sky, and there is a lighthouse in the distance on a land outcrop. An old boat rests on the beach near where the pebbles meet the sand. The sky has textured clouds indicating an overcast day. The image uses a monochromatic palette of gray, black, and white. The technique seems to use fine strokes, possibly etching, giving the scene detailed precision and softness.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Man in Profile
artworks.medium: red chalk with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person in profile view, facing left. The person appears seated and still, with their gaze directed sideways. Their facial features, short hair, and clothing are detailed. There are no accessories visible on the person. The background has a textured surface, contrasting with the fine lines of the drawing done in a reddish-brown tone.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony and the Two Temptresses (Saint Antoine et deux Tentatrices)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with a figure on the cross and another figure nearby. The drawing is done using bold and expressive lines. The figure on the left is depicted with arms raised, nailed to a cross, with the suggestion of a crown of thorns resting above the forehead. The second figure is shown standing with a somber expression, draped with a robe or veil that flows to the ground. Another smaller figure is shown at the feet of the standing figure. The minimal lines create a dramatic impact, emphasizing the gravity of the scene.

artworks.title: Young Man (Jeune Homme)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image is an illustration showing a person's upper body from behind. The person is facing away from the viewer but slightly turned to the side, showing their facial profile. The face has soft features, and the hair is styled in a braid or twisted bun. The person appears unclothed, with bare shoulders and back visible, no visible accessories or objects. The background has abstract swirling lines and shapes, including a circular form suggesting movement.

artworks.title: The Queen of Sheba (La Reine de Saba)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image depicts an individual shown from the waist up, seated in a relaxed position with eyes seemingly closed or gazing downward. The person has long, dark hair adorned with an ornate headpiece decorated with floral patterns. Their facial features include a softly contoured face with subtle shading to indicate eyebrows and lips. The person appears to be unclothed, with minimal lines suggesting the outline of the torso and arms. To the right of the person, an animal, resembling a cat, is rendered. The background of the image is plain and off-white. The artwork is rendered in a loose, sketch-like style with bold black lines.

artworks.title: Apollonius
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on buff wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person's upper body in a side profile. The person has a prominent nose, defined chin, and short, dark hair styled to one side. They are holding an object with intricate patterns in front of their face. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Shadow (L'Ombre)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows flowing lines forming an abstract composition with an outline of a human profile. The shapes and lines intertwine, suggesting a wavy, water-like effect surrounding the figure. The central shape resembles a woman's face in profile, with contours suggesting hair or a hood draped over her head. The abstract design evokes the emergence of familiar elements within dynamic lines.

artworks.title: The Devil (Le Diable)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection, Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract representation of a person's full body, including their head to toe. The figure is depicted standing upright with arms at the sides. Minimalistic facial features are shown, including closed eyes, a small nose, and a subtle smile. The head is surrounded by flowing hair that merges into an ornate circular pattern. The person wears a detailed garment with various patterns, including texture at the top and a rectangular emblem with semicircular and linear designs at the bottom. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Exegi Monumentum (Art Inscribing Minerva's Shield)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. The figure on the left is seated on a chair, holding a spear, wearing a helmet, draped in elaborate clothing. The figure on the right stands beside the seated figure, holding a scroll. Both figures have distinct hairstyles and are dressed in classical attire. The background includes classical architectural elements and structures under a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Chattanooga, Tennessee, South End
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with sparse vegetation near the viewer and denser vegetation in the distance. A hill or ridge covered in vegetation is visible near the horizon. The image has a sepia tone, giving it an aged appearance. In the distance, there are clusters of trees, a bridge or pathway, and reflections in a body of water on the right side.

artworks.title: Strong’s near McMillan’s Ferry
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a water wheel on the left side. The scene includes a path along a river, a wooden bridge, and tall trees forming a canopy above. The colors are earthy and a sepia wash is applied. The details of the water, foliage, and wooden structures are clear and sharp, highlighting the historical and natural aspects of the setting.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Painting on Parnassus
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bert Freidus Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene set in a forested landscape with classical architecture in the background. It includes various figures engaged in different activities, integrated into a natural setting. The central focus is on a chariot pulled by horses, with figures surrounding it. A female figure above appears to be floating or emerging from a tree, surrounded by light. The forest is detailed with trees and foliage, while distant hills and a classical building frame the background. The foreground features figures and animals such as a lion in dynamic poses and interactions, capturing a moment of action.

artworks.title: Cascade at the Chateau de St. Cloud
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alexander Novak and Family
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a decorative outdoor fountain and garden. The image showcases a series of water features forming a cascading fountain, set against a backdrop of lush foliage and trees. The fountain is adorned with sculptural elements, including classical urns and a statue. Water cascades gently over several levels, creating a serene scene. The sepia tone of the image adds to its elegant feel. The composition emphasizes the interplay between the fountain's architecture and the surrounding natural environment.
